challenges.title: File-system routing and params
challenges.prompt: Implement toRoute (strip app/, route groups and the leaf file) and match: static segments, [x], [...x] and [[...x]] with parameters, preferring routes with more static segments, and 404 for unknown URLs. It models how the App Router maps folders to URLs.
challenges.explain: Folders become URL segments, parenthesized groups disappear, brackets create params and the most specific route wins. This models the idea, not Next's actual router. Verified by running the solution with Node.

challenges.title: Time-based and tag-based revalidation
challenges.prompt: Implement DataCache.get so entries are served from cache while fresh, refetched after `revalidate` seconds or after revalidateTag invalidates them, and counted as origin fetches. A fake clock drives the scenario.
challenges.expected:
first request                  origin       posts v1
30s later (still fresh)        cache        posts v1
61s later (expired)            revalidated  posts v2
immediately again              cache        posts v2
after revalidateTag('posts')   revalidated  posts v3
force-cache forever            origin       posts v3
much later, still cached       cache        posts v3
origin fetches: 4
challenges.explain: Next's data cache serves fresh entries, revalidates after a time window (ISR) and can be invalidated on demand by tag, so unnecessary origin fetches are avoided. This is a simplified model. Verified by running the solution with Node.
